read.thesis: Delta cut off-peak capacity and is recapturing fuel: Q2 revenue guided up low-teens on flat capacity, 6-8% operating margin, and 40-50% of the $2B+ fuel headwind recaptured, with a downward capacity bias.

triggers.label: Off-peak capacity cut, downward bias
triggers.quote: we're meaningfully reducing capacity in the current quarter with a downward bias until we see the fuel situation improve
triggers.highlight: meaningfully reducing capacity in the current quarter

triggers.label: Fuel recapture 40-50% in Q2
triggers.quote: recapturing 40% to 50% of the more than $2 billion of fuel headwind in the quarter

triggers.label: Industry rationalisation from high fuel
triggers.quote: higher fuel prices will cause much more significant structural reform than we've seen over this period

triggers.label: Cash sales up mid-teens in March
triggers.quote: Cash sales grew mid-teens in March, with momentum extending into April
triggers.highlight: Cash sales grew mid-teens in March

triggers.label: Q2 op margin 6-8%, EPS $1-1.50
triggers.quote: we expect a second quarter operating margin of 6% to 8%, with earnings per share of $1 to $1.50
triggers.highlight: second quarter operating margin of 6% to 8%

prior_guidance_check.quote: while it's still early to update the full year outlook

red_flags.label: Reliability and recovery lapses
red_flags.quote: our reliability and recovery haven't met consistently enough our high standards

red_flags.label: Nonfuel unit costs up 6%
red_flags.quote: Nonfuel unit costs grew 6% over prior year

red_flags.label: Q2 free cash flow hit
red_flags.quote: The second quarter will be impacted from where we expect the quarter is versus our current guide

evasions.quote: We're not in a position given how dramatic the fuel swings have been to really answer that.
